tolino shine - the basics 
Turning your tolino shine on and off 
The on/off button is located at the back of your eReader. 
 
You can switch off your eReader or put it into sleep mode when 
you're not reading. Both help to extend the battery life.  
The main difference between these two options is that when you 
switch your eReader back on from sleep mode, you will be taken 
straight back to the most recent item you viewed.  This can be a 
page in the book, your bookshop or a shelf in your library. If you 
 
6 
switch off your eReader, you will return to the Homepage after 
switching it on. 
Please note that processes like syncing your library and establishing 
a WiFi connection may be interrupted when you put your eReader 
into sleep mode. 
How to switch on your eReader: 
• 
Press and hold the on/off button until your eReader turns 
on. 
To switch off your eReader: 
• 
Press and hold the power button until the Off screen 
appears.  
To put your eReader into sleep mode: 
• 
Press the on/off button and release it quickly. 
To switch the eReader on again: 
• 
Press the on/off button and release it again.

Charging your eReader 
Before using your tolino shine for the first time, you should charge 
it for at least an hour. 
If possible, charge your tolino shine using the included USB-C cable.  
 
The power delivered by the charger must be 10 Watts to achieve 
the maximum charging speed. 
 
Tips for maintaining and charging the battery 
Lithium-ion batteries power most electronic devices these days, 
this includes devices such as your smartphone and laptop. These 
batteries are safe and reliable. It's important to stay informed 
about the safety of lithium-ion batteries to ensure safe operation of 
your eReader. This will give you the longest battery life: 
• 
If possible, charge your eReader using the included 
charging cable. 
 
8 
• 
Remove the charging cable once your device is fully 
charged. This will prevent overcharging and have a 
beneficial effect on your eReader's battery life. 
• 
Charge your eReader while it's on a hard surface. Charging 
your eReader on soft surfaces like your bed may prevent 
the battery from cooling down properly and cause your 
eReader to overheat. 
 
 
Follow these instructions to charge your eReader. 
1. Turn on your computer. 
2. Connect your USB-C cable to your eReader and your 
computer, or connect a USB wall charger (not included). 
 
 
9 
You can continue reading while your eReader is charging. The 
battery status is displayed at the top right of the screen. 
You can also charge your tolino shine using any 5V, 2A USB-C 
adapter. 
Note: If you're traveling to a country with alternative electrical 
power outlets to those where you live, make sure you have access 
to a suitable adapter before attempting to charge your tolino shine.

Using your eReader near water 
Both your eReader screen and your hands should be dry to ensure 
an optimal reading experience. Should the screen get wet, simply 
wipe it with a dry cloth. Your screen may not respond as normal 
when used in wet conditions or underwater. 
 
Rinse your eReader with water immediately after contact with one 
of the following liquids and dry it before using it again. This will 
extend the life of your eReader. 
 
• 
Salt water 
• 
Soapy water 
• 
Chlorinated water from a pool 
 
Your eReader can withstand immersion in 2 meters of fresh water 
for up to 1 hour if you follow these instructions. 
 
Your eReader is IPX8 certified. This means that it has been tested 
and certified as water-resistant under certain conditions. 
 
If you follow the instructions below, you can prevent water damage 
to your eReader. Please note that your eReader is not dust or sand 
proof. 
 
 
17 
• 
Make sure the USB port is dry before connecting a USB 
charger to your eReader. 
• 
Avoid exposing your eReader to strong jets of water, such 
as waterfalls or waves. 
• 
Do not charge your eReader while in or near water, or in 
areas with high humidity. 
• 
Your eReader will not float on the surface of water. Do not 
immerse it in water deeper than 2 meters. 
• 
Do not immerse your eReader in water for longer than 60 
minutes.

Troubleshooting on your eReader 
Forcing your eReader to power off 
If your eReader stops responding or is frozen, it can be useful to try 
forcing it to power off. 
1. Press and hold the power button until the OFF screen 
appears. Note: If the sleep screen appears, turn your 
eReader back on and try turning it off again. 
2. Press and hold the on/off button until your eReader turns 
on. 
If your eReader has frozen and cannot be switched off, try charging 
your eReader. 
 
Logging out of your eReader 
Logging out of your eReader and logging back in can also help to 
resolve common issues. When you log back in, your eReader will 
return to the setup process. You will need to enter the email 
address and password associated with your tolino account to set up 
your eReader using a WiFi connection.

Resetting your eReader to factory settings 
Use factory reset to restore your tolino shine to its original settings. 
After performing a factory reset, you'll need to set up and sync your 
eReader again. 
When you reset your eReader: 
• 
All books will be removed from your eReader. Any books 
purchased from your tolino book store can be downloaded 
again after the factory reset is complete. 
• 
You will lose any bookmarks and annotations that have 
been added to books since you last synced your eReader. 
• 
You will be logged out of your eReader account. 
• 
All your settings and preferences will be restored. 
• 
Your eReader will be reset to its original settings. 
To reset your eReader: 
1. Go to your home screen. 
2. Tap 
 More at the bottom of the screen. 
3. Tap Settings. 
4. Tap Device info. 
 
47 
5. Under "Advanced," tap Factory Reset. 
6. Tap Reset now. 
After resetting your eReader, follow the on-screen steps to set 
up your eReader once more. 
 
Manually resetting your eReader

try performing a manual reset to factory settings to restore the 
original settings of your eReader. 
After a manual reset to factory settings, you must reset and sync 
your eReader again.
